The '''Beetle Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that was located within the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Beetle Nebula was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The ''Atlas'' placed the nebula in grid square N-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
